Hi Jane / Acme security team,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap of the pain points and goals we heard on the call:

- Primary pain: need SOC 2 Type II evidence and clear audit-log retention for regulatory reporting.
- Secondary: DPA with standard security controls, proof of recent pen test, and ability to support SSO + customer-managed KMS for encryption.
- Goal: determine whether Redwood can satisfy Acme's compliance checklists and procurement timelines for a pilot in Q3.

What we committed to share (next steps):
1) SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level pen test summary (attached).
2) Sample audit-log export and explanation of retention options (attached sample-audit-logs.csv).
3) Draft DPA for your legal team to review (attached redirect to DocuSign link below).
4) Technical notes on encryption/KMS and data residency options (Dev will follow up).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-type2-report-2024.pdf, redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf, sample-audit-logs.csv, redwood-dpa-draft-acme.docx

Proposed timeline:
- Today (June 25): share artifacts (below)
- Week of June 30: follow-up call with security + dev to walk logs and KMS options
- July 7: procurement check-in for next steps / PO timeline

If that looks right, I'll send a calendar invite for the follow-up. Please let us know any other documents you need (e.g., ISO, penetration test full report, or encrypt-at-rest architecture diagram).

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and for sharing the artifacts.

A few clarifying requests from our side:
- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report covers hosted (shared) and dedicated deployments or only hosted?
- For the pen test, we typically request steps to remediate high/critical findings — is there an executive summary available that lists remediation status?
- For audit logs: what's the maximum retention configurable by customer? We need at least 3 years for some teams; some records may require 7 years.
- Encryption: does Redwood support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via our cloud KMS? If so, how is key rotation handled and is key material ever exported?
- Can you share a sample DPA with the redlined sections you typically see? Procurement would like to review terms (liability caps / data retention / subprocessors).

Also looped procurement (procurement@acme.com) — can you send estimate / pricing band for a pilot (4 vCPU equivalent / reserved capacity for X requests per month)?

Thanks,
Jane

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA (Acme)

Hi Jane,

Following up with technical details — a short summary below, happy to deep-dive on the follow-up call.

SOC 2 scope:
- Our SOC 2 Type II (attached) covers our hosted API environment and managed infrastructure. For Dedicated (reserved capacity) customers, we provide a scoped report and can run an SOC attestation on the dedicated environment as part of an enterprise onboarding — we can include dedicated scope in effort/contract.

Pen test summary:
- Attached redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf (exec summary). Critical/high findings were addressed; the full remediation tracker is available under NDA — we can share during the security call.

Audit logs & retention:
- Audit logs (API request/response metadata, auth events, admin actions) are stored in our logging pipeline (immutable append-only bucket) and exported to customer S3 on request.
- Default retention: 1 year. Configurable retention up to 7 years via enterprise add-on (policy + storage costs apply). We can set per-account retention policies.

Encryption & KMS:
- Encryption at rest: AES-256 by default.
- Customer-managed keys (BYOK): supported via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Keys are never exported by Redwood; we use envelope encryption. Rotation is supported and can be automated or manual — we provide rotation logs.

Data residency:
- Hosted: US/EU regional endpoints available. Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) keeps control in-customer network.

Next steps I can take now:
- Share a sample audit-log export (attached sample-audit-logs.csv) and a short walkthrough on the follow-up call.
- Provide a DocuSign link for the DPA draft: https://docusign.com/agreements/abcd-1234
- Schedule a technical call — proposed slots: June 30 14:00-15:00 PT or July 1 10:00-11:00 PT.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary-2024.pdf, sample-audit-logs.csv

Thanks,
